usage: CallVariantsFromCffiGPU.py [-h] [--platform PLATFORM]
                                  [--tensor_fn TENSOR_FN]
                                  [--full_aln_files FULL_ALN_FILES]
                                  [--output_dir OUTPUT_DIR]
                                  [--chkpnt_fn CHKPNT_FN] [--call_fn CALL_FN]
                                  [--gvcf GVCF] [--ref_fn REF_FN]
                                  [--ctgName CTGNAME] [--ctgStart CTGSTART]
                                  [--ctgEnd CTGEND] [--sampleName SAMPLENAME]
                                  [--qual QUAL] [--samtools SAMTOOLS]
                                  [--temp_file_dir TEMP_FILE_DIR]
                                  [--haploid_precise] [--haploid_sensitive]
                                  [--enable_long_indel ENABLE_LONG_INDEL]
                                  [--keep_iupac_bases KEEP_IUPAC_BASES]
                                  [--enable_dwell_time ENABLE_DWELL_TIME]
                                  [--use_gpu USE_GPU] [--threads THREADS]
                                  [--predict_fn PREDICT_FN]
                                  [--input_probabilities]
                                  [--output_probabilities]
                                  [--enable_variant_calling_at_sequence_head_and_tail ENABLE_VARIANT_CALLING_AT_SEQUENCE_HEAD_AND_TAIL]
                                  --bam_fn BAM_FN [--bed_fn [BED_FN]]
                                  [--snp_min_af SNP_MIN_AF]
                                  [--indel_min_af INDEL_MIN_AF]
                                  [--extend_bed [EXTEND_BED]]
                                  [--vcf_fn VCF_FN]
                                  [--minCoverage MINCOVERAGE] [--minMQ MINMQ]
                                  [--minBQ MINBQ] [--max_depth MAX_DEPTH]
                                  [--fast_mode FAST_MODE]
                                  [--call_snp_only CALL_SNP_ONLY]
                                  [--base_err BASE_ERR]
                                  [--gq_bin_size GQ_BIN_SIZE]
                                  [--bp_resolution]
                                  [--phased_vcf_fn PHASED_VCF_FN]
                                  [--no_phasing_for_fa NO_PHASING_FOR_FA]
                                  [--parallel PARALLEL] [--pypy PYPY]
                                  [--python PYTHON]
                                  [--cpu_threads CPU_THREADS]
                                  [--gpu_threads GPU_THREADS]
                                  [--internal_threads INTERNAL_THREADS]
                                  [--device DEVICE]

The wrapper of GPU Call variants

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --platform PLATFORM   Sequencing platform of the input. Options:
                        'ont,hifi,ilmn', default: ont
  --tensor_fn TENSOR_FN
                        Tensor input filename, or stdin if not set
  --full_aln_files FULL_ALN_FILES
                        Tensor input filename, or stdin if not set
  --output_dir OUTPUT_DIR
                        Tensor input filename, or stdin if not set
  --chkpnt_fn CHKPNT_FN
                        Input a trained model for variant calling, required
  --call_fn CALL_FN     VCF output filename, or stdout if not set
  --gvcf GVCF           Enable GVCF output, default: disabled
  --ref_fn REF_FN       Reference fasta file input, required if --gvcf is
                        enabled
  --ctgName CTGNAME     The name of the sequence to be processed
  --ctgStart CTGSTART   The 1-based starting position of the sequence to be
                        processed, optional, will process the whole --ctgName
                        if not set
  --ctgEnd CTGEND       The 1-based inclusive ending position of the sequence
                        to be processed, optional, will process the whole
                        --ctgName if not set
  --sampleName SAMPLENAME
                        Define the sample name to be shown in the VCF file,
                        optional
  --qual QUAL           If set, variants with >=$qual will be marked 'PASS',
                        or 'LowQual' otherwise, optional
  --samtools SAMTOOLS   Path to the 'samtools', samtools version >= 1.10 is
                        required, default: samtools
  --temp_file_dir TEMP_FILE_DIR
                        EXPERIMENTAL: The cache directory for storing
                        temporary non-variant information if --gvcf is
                        enabled, default: ./
  --haploid_precise     EXPERIMENTAL: Enable haploid calling mode. Only 1/1 is
                        considered as a variant
  --haploid_sensitive   EXPERIMENTAL: Enable haploid calling mode. 0/1 and 1/1
                        are considered as a variant
  --enable_long_indel ENABLE_LONG_INDEL
                        EXPERIMENTAL: Enable long Indel variants(>50 bp)
                        calling
  --keep_iupac_bases KEEP_IUPAC_BASES
                        EXPERIMENTAL: Keep IUPAC (non ACGTN) reference and
                        alternate bases, default: convert all IUPAC bases to N
  --enable_dwell_time ENABLE_DWELL_TIME
                        EXPERIMENTAL: Enable dwell time channel for full-
                        alignment tensors
  --use_gpu USE_GPU     Use GPU for calling
  --threads THREADS     How many threads for python to use for parallelization
                        default: 1.000000
  --predict_fn PREDICT_FN
                        DEBUG: Output network output probabilities for further
                        analysis
  --input_probabilities
                        DEBUG: Use network probability outputs as input and
                        generate variants from them
  --output_probabilities
                        DEBUG: Output the network probabilities of gt21,
                        genotype, indel_length_1 and indel_length_2
  --enable_variant_calling_at_sequence_head_and_tail ENABLE_VARIANT_CALLING_AT_SEQUENCE_HEAD_AND_TAIL
                        EXPERIMENTAL: Enable variant calling in sequence head
                        and tail start or end regions that flanking 16bp
                        windows having no read support. Default: disable.
  --bam_fn BAM_FN       Sorted BAM file input, required
  --bed_fn [BED_FN]     Call variant only in the provided regions. Will take
                        an intersection if --ctgName and/or (--ctgStart,
                        --ctgEnd) are set
  --snp_min_af SNP_MIN_AF
                        Minimum snp allele frequency for a site to be
                        considered as a candidate site, default: 0.080000
  --indel_min_af INDEL_MIN_AF
                        Minimum indel allele frequency for a site to be
                        considered as a candidate site, default: 0.150000
  --extend_bed [EXTEND_BED]
                        DEBUG: Extend the regions in the --bed_fn by a few bp
                        for tensor creation, default extend 16bp
  --vcf_fn VCF_FN       Candidate sites VCF file input, if provided, variants
                        will only be called at the sites in the VCF file,
                        default: None
  --minCoverage MINCOVERAGE
                        EXPERIMENTAL: Minimum coverage required to call a
                        variant, default: 2.000000
  --minMQ MINMQ         EXPERIMENTAL: If set, reads with mapping quality with
                        <$minMQ are filtered, default: 5
  --minBQ MINBQ         EXPERIMENTAL: If set, bases with base quality with
                        <$minBQ are filtered, default: 0
  --max_depth MAX_DEPTH
                        EXPERIMENTAL: Maximum full alignment depth to be
                        processed. default: 144
  --fast_mode FAST_MODE
                        EXPERIMENTAL: Skip variant candidates with AF <= 0.15,
                        default: False
  --call_snp_only CALL_SNP_ONLY
                        EXPERIMENTAL: Call candidates pass snp minimum AF
                        only, ignore Indel candidates
  --base_err BASE_ERR   DEBUG: Estimated base error rate in gvcf option,
                        default: 0.001000
  --gq_bin_size GQ_BIN_SIZE
                        DEBUG: Default gq bin size for merge non-variant block
                        in gvcf option, default: 5
  --bp_resolution       DEBUG: Enable bp resolution for GVCF, default:
                        disabled
  --phased_vcf_fn PHASED_VCF_FN
                        Use heterozygous SNP variants in phased vcf file for
                        haplotaging
  --no_phasing_for_fa NO_PHASING_FOR_FA
                        EXPERIMENTAL: Call variants without whatshap or
                        longphase phasing in full alignment calling
  --parallel PARALLEL   Absolute path of parallel, parallel >= 20191122 is
                        required.
  --pypy PYPY           Absolute path of pypy3, pypy3 >= 3.6 is required.
  --python PYTHON       Absolute path of pypy3, pypy3 >= 3.6 is required.
  --cpu_threads CPU_THREADS
                        How many threads for python to use for parallelization
                        default: 4.000000
  --gpu_threads GPU_THREADS
                        How many threads for python to use for parallelization
                        default: 4.000000
  --internal_threads INTERNAL_THREADS
                        How many threads for python to use for parallelization
                        default: 1.000000
  --device DEVICE       Specify the GPUs for calling default: 'cuda:auto'
